title: Positive-real evaluation classifies monotone Schur-semiring homomorphisms with trivial kernel
author: Fritz, Tobias
work: Asymptotic and catalytic containment of representations of $\mathrm{SU}(n)$

primary_locator.required_new_core: exact preordered Schur-positive semiring and total-positive coefficient/minor real-root forcing; all Section3 prerequisites and proof retained

difficulty_reason: The converse reconstructs an evaluation point from elementary symmetric functions and proves its coordinates are positive real using total positivity of the coefficient matrix and skew-Schur Jacobi–Trudi minors. The nonroutine obligation is real-root forcing from Schur positivity, not the easy forward evaluation homomorphism check.

source_check.note: The selected problem is Proposition3.2: monotone real-valued Schur-positive-semiring homomorphisms with trivial kernel are exactly evaluation at strictly positive real coordinates. Full native Sections1--3 retain the semiring/order/kernel conventions, symmetric-function root reconstruction, complete coefficient-matrix/skew-Schur-minor positivity and real-negative-root argument. Aissen--Whitney and its cited full proof, and standard Jacobi--Trudi facts remain named prerequisites; the author attributes the final argument to Richard Stanley. Later representation quotient/catalytic-containment results are unselected. All proof text/formulas remain editable original TeX. Frozen above-qualification and independent-unit approval retained; no new material or mathematical review.
